authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7 aṃsiya explicitly gives Nepali hã̄siyo, Bengali/Hindi hã̄siyā and Bihari hãsuā sickle, as well as Kumaoni ã̄sī scythe. The selected forms preserve these y-bearing, u-bearing and h-less variants; uncertain regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form hə̃sĩya is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1348 āryaka explicitly gives Bhojpuri ājā grandfather, ājī grandmother and Oriya ajā maternal grandfather. These aja/aji/aje forms fit the documented kinship family; source relationship specificity is retained. Exact survey form aǰa is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
